description:
Scope: planning only for lib/zaq/engine/conversations/token_usage_aggregator.ex lines 33, 34, 35 (and adjacent error return at 38). No implementation, test execution, source/docs edits or Git mutations. Related ongoing accounting issue: zaq-7uz; this is exclusively the rescue-path test surface. Exclusive test path: test/zaq/engine/conversations/token_usage_aggregator_test.exs. No other test or support file planned.

Functional specification / branch map: perform/1 returns {:error, Exception.message(exception)} and logs [TokenUsageAggregator] Failed for conversation <id>: <reason> when a matched job raises. Line 33 binds the rescued exception; line 34 invokes Logger.error; line 35 formats the conversation ID and exception message. The success :ok branch already has extensive tests; do not change it. Add test A: create a valid conversation with the existing Conversations.create_conversation/1 or create_conv_with_assistant_msg/3 helper; pass its ID, model "gpt-4", and an unparseable explicit date (e.g. "not-a-date") to perform_job(TokenUsageAggregator, args). Explicit CaptureLog.capture_log wraps invocation; assert {:error, reason}, reason nonempty and contains the date-parsing diagnostic (verify actual Date.from_iso8601!/1 wording before committing an exact assertion), and log contains the exact prefix with ^conversation.id and the same reason. Check persisted conversation.metadata unchanged; invalid date fails before transaction. Use a fixed invalid date, not wall-clock-sensitive input.

Add test B: construct a positive integer conversation ID not present in Repo (derive a unique candidate and verify absence, or insert a conversation then delete it in this sandbox before invocation); use valid explicit Date.to_iso8601(Date.utc_today()) and model "gpt-4"; assert {:error, reason}, reason identifies Ecto.NoResultsError/no matching Conversation without overfitting full Ecto inspect output, and captured error log contains the missing ID and same reason. This exercises exception from Repo.one!/1 inside Repo.transaction/1 and confirms worker handles the database failure instead of returning :ok. Do not pass nil or missing args: those bypass the matching perform clause or make the log interpolation misleading and are not the target contract. If delete approach triggers unrelated callbacks/foreign keys, use generated candidate plus Repo.get(Conversation, id) == nil instead.

Helpers and boundaries: keep existing use Zaq.DataCase, async: true, use Oban.Testing, repo: Zaq.Repo, and @moduletag capture_log: true; import ExUnit.CaptureLog in the test file if needed. Reuse existing conversation builder/context; use perform_job/2 to exercise real worker and real Repo, not a mock of Repo, logger, worker or internal helper. Assert return tuple and captured log, not just line hit. Sandbox owns DB state. No new fixtures, Mox mocks, app-env mutation, process names, sleeps or global shared mode; CaptureLog only around local synchronous job execution. If ExUnit automatic capture interferes with explicit capture, prefer targeted capture_log/1 in the test rather than altering global logging configuration. No E2E: pure backend worker regression.

Property assessment: existing retry-safe accounting property covers broad sums/idempotence; these are two concrete exception boundaries and logging side effects, so a new generated property is unnecessary. Action reuse: not applicable — tests only, no executable operation added or changed; reuse existing worker public perform_job contract.

Validation for later implementer only (not in this planning task): write failure tests first; run isolated mix test test/zaq/engine/conversations/token_usage_aggregator_test.exs through Context Mode and verify these scenarios cover lines 33-35 in a fresh report at coverage handoff. Run mix q and required final mix precommit per docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md; do not weaken current assertions. Blockers/unreachable: none known for invalid-date or missing-conversation exceptions; if Oban.Testing.perform_job transforms {:error, reason} unexpectedly, call TokenUsageAggregator.perform(%Oban.Job{args: args}) directly as the documented worker contract rather than introducing production test seams. If line 35 cannot run because exception message/logging raises on malformed IDs, report the contract defect, do not mark covered by an unrelated exception.
title: [coverage] Test TokenUsageAggregator error handling (lines 33-35)
